quiz.title: langue anglaise : vocabulaire, grammaire, expressions courantes
quiz.subject: Anglais

answers.correction: 'I am' is indeed the correct way to say 'je suis' in English.
'Hello' is a common English greeting used to say hi or welcome someone.
'The cat is on the table' is indeed a grammatically correct sentence in English, as it follows the subject-verb-object structure and uses proper prepositions.
'Happy' is an adjective because it describes a noun (a person, place, or thing) by expressing a quality or state of being.
'Thank you' is indeed a phrase used to express gratitude in English.
'See you later' is a common English expression used to say goodbye or indicate that you will see someone again in the future.
'The dog is barking loudly' is indeed a grammatically correct sentence in English, as it follows the subject-verb-adverb structure and uses proper verb tense.
